hypothesis: Avoiding Saturday/Sunday exposure may improve net returns or drawdown after costs; this is a calendar rule, not a directional indicator or opening-range breakout.
timing: At Sunday 23:00 UTC close, buy at contiguous Monday 00:00 UTC open; sell at Saturday 00:00 UTC open. Skip weeks whose planned exit is outside the window. If a gap occurs while holding, liquidate at first observed open. No intrabar stop, no short, no leverage.
selection: One rule only, no parameter variants, no tuning. Development and validation first; final is calculated only after this protocol and the screen output are saved. The final dates were used by earlier project studies and are not an untouched cross-project holdout.
